jobs.job: Start and stop per indoor unit group
jobs.how: Instances shown are for indoor unit 000; every group uses the same layout, with instance = unit number x 256 + member. Write BO 1 to start or stop a group and read BI 2 back.

points.use: Write stops whole DIII-Net line; clearing does not restart

jobs.how: Write the mode to MO 5 and read MI 6 to confirm. Note the status object has no Auto state: 4 is 'not used' on MI 6.

points.use: Write 1 cool, 2 heat, 3 fan, 4 auto, 5 dry

jobs.how: Write AV 10 only when the value changes. Out-of-range values are rounded to the unit's limits and F/C conversion can read back slightly different; do not keep resending until it matches.

points.use: Write setpoint; avoid cyclic writes (non-volatile memory)
Read room temp; reference only, skewed when fan off or defrosting

jobs.how: Fan speed and airflow direction are saved in the indoor unit's non-volatile memory, so write them on change only.

points.use: Read fan speed: 1 low, 2 high, 3 middle, 4 auto

jobs.how: Lock local remote controllers out of on/off, mode or setpoint per group. Daikin central controllers can still change on/off, mode and setpoint unless CL_Rejection is active on that line's first unit.

points.use: Write Active = prohibit remote mode change
Write Active = prohibit remote setpoint change

jobs.how: Alarm and communication status are per group. MI 4 reads 1 when normal; any other state is a Daikin malfunction code.

points.use: Read 1 = normal, other = Daikin malfunction code
Read Active = communication error with the unit
Write to reset the filter sign

jobs.how: These members apply to VAM units only. Write the ventilation mode and amount and read the status objects back.

points.use: Read ventilation mode: 1 bypass, 2 ERV, 3 auto
Write 1 low, 2 high, 3 auto (4-6 fresh up)

jobs.how: Accumulated gas and power need the optional power-proportional-distribution setup. Both are read-only totals per group.

checklist: Confirm the interface runs Ver. 6.20 or later and commission it with the Daikin test-operation/setup tool.
Set the BACnet/IP port (factory 47808) and, if the BMS is on another subnet, register the interface as a foreign device with the BBMD.
After power-up wait about a minute for indoor unit discovery, since reads return UNKNOWN_OBJECT until then.
Work out each group's instances as unit number x 256 + member, so unit 001's BO 1 (StartStopCommand_001) is BO 257.
Read BI 2 (StartStopStatus), AI 9 (RoomTemp), MI 6 (AirConModeStatus) and BI 20 (CommunicationStatus) for every group.
Test one group by writing BO 1 (StartStopCommand) on, checking BI 2 follows, then writing it off again.
Set the BMS to write setpoint, on/off, mode, fan speed and airflow direction only on change, because they go to non-volatile memory with a write-count limit.
Decide on lockouts: BV 13/14/16 per group, and BV 17 (CL_Rejection) on units 000/064/128/192 if central controllers must not override the BMS.
Map BI 3 (Alarm), MI 4 (MalfunctionCode) and BI 20 (CommunicationStatus) as alarms for every group.
